title: The Real Reason You Value Hard-Earned Rewards More
hook: You will always value a hard-won reward more than a free gift.

narration.text: You will always value a hard-won reward more than a free gift.
This is called the effort justification effect.
Our brains want to believe our hard work was worthwhile.
So, we increase the subjective value of what we worked for.
This makes us feel more satisfied with the outcome.
Think about assembling flat-pack furniture yourself.
It feels more special than if someone built it for you.
Where have you noticed this effect in your own life?

description: Have you ever wondered why that project you poured hours into felt more rewarding than something easily given? It is all down to the effort justification effect. Our minds tend to place a higher value on things we have worked hard to achieve, making those rewards feel more satisfying.
topic: Why you feel more satisfied after earning a reward than just receiving it, explaining the effort justification effect.
